summary: GigaMedia filed a 6-K reporting its subscription for 719.09 million Aeolus Robotics Series C preferred shares via conversion and settlement of convertible promissory notes originally purchased from September 2023 to February 2026, with total principal of US$12.37 million at an average price of ~US$0.0176 per share. Post-transaction, GigaMedia holds 719.83 million preferred shares representing approximately 33.35% voting rights, shifting accounting from available-for-sale to equity method. The transaction is a strategic investment to support Aeolus's AI-enabled service robot development. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for additional securities transactions and Aeolus's commercialization milestones.
